title: Credential Session Auth
problem: Nako has users, roles, and Library Access but no durable local credential/session authority for real user login.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-server -E 'test(local_session_auth) | test(admin_v1_access_management) | test(bearer_auth)' --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p nako-api -E 'test(public_openapi) | test(admin_contract) | test(sdk)' --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened backend-only credential/session auth lane and recorded the accepted local credential/session direction in ADR 0037.
Added local credential and user session records, repository methods, SQLite/PostgreSQL baseline schema support, and focused credential/session storage contract coverage.
Added Admin API local password set/rotate/delete behavior for existing users, redaction-safe account credential state, and refreshed the generated Admin Web contract.

Added Public Client login/current-account/logout routes, Bearer session principal resolution, disabled-user rejection, bootstrap admin compatibility, OpenAPI updates, and refreshed Rust/TypeScript/Kotlin client contracts.
Closed the credential/session auth lane after fresh focused server, DB, API, client, protocol, formatting, JSON, and whitespace gates passed.

continue_policy.notes: Credential/session backend authority is complete. Start focused follow-on lanes for Admin Web account UI, Media Web login/account switching, cookie transport, invitation onboarding, recovery, SSO, or Management Context Links instead of reopening this lane.
